item.title: FOIL Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: frustrate, thwart, foil, baffle, balk mean to check or defeat another's plan or block achievement of a goal. frustrate implies making vain or ineffectual all efforts however vigorous or persistent.

item.title: Offender Search - TN.gov
item.description: MyTN provides Felony Offender Information and a wide variety of other services and resources within Tennessee in an easy, efficient, and secure way. Go to MyTN for a list of services available and a link to download the app. After you have downloaded the app, click on Public Safety to access FOIL.

item.title: Foil (metal) - Wikipedia
item.description: A foil is a very thin sheet of metal, typically made by hammering or rolling. [1][2] Foils are most easily made with malleable metal, such as aluminium, copper, [3] tin, and gold.

item.title: FOIL Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com
item.description: As a verb, if you foil someone's plans or attempts to do something, you cause them to fail. Your brother will be really mad if you foil his plans to hide his mediocre report card from your parents.

item.title: Foil - definition of foil by The Free Dictionary
item.description: One that stands in contrast to and emphasizes the distinctive characteristics of another: "I am resolved my husband shall not be a rival, but a foil to me" (Charlotte Brontë).

item.title: FOIL - NYC.gov
item.description: A Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request is a request to obtain records/documents from New York State or local government agencies. DOI proactively publishes the public findings of investigations on our reports page, so it may be useful to check before making a FOIL request.

item.title: Hydrofoil explained simply – foil technology and history
item.description: In this article, we take a comprehensive look at the technology, history, and various applications of hydrofoils in surfing. We place a special focus on the innovative eFoil, which is enjoying rapidly growing popularity.
